name: Account Closure Process
description: End-to-end procedure for closing a customer account, encompassing identity verification, final balance calculation, standing order and direct debit processing, closure type assessment, balance remittance, and record archival. Applies to both customer-initiated and bank-initiated closures with different timelines and investigation requirements.
context: Timeline: 3–5 business days (customer-initiated), Immediate (bank-initiated with notice)
purpose: Close customer account and remit final balance
trigger: Customer closure request or bank-initiated closure decision
outcome_success: Account marked closed in system, final balance remitted, records archived
outcome_failure: Unresolved standing orders/direct debits, balance not transferred, account remains active

name: Closure Request Reception
description: Initial step where a closure request is received from the customer or initiated by the bank. This triggers the account closure workflow.
input: Closure request from customer or bank decision notice
output: Closure request logged and routed for verification

name: Customer Identity Verification
description: Verification step to confirm the identity of the customer requesting account closure or the authorized representative initiating a bank-led closure.
output: Identity verified, customer confirmed as account holder

name: Final Balance Calculation
description: Computation of the account's final balance, including all accrued interest, fees, and pending transactions as of the closure date.
input: Account transaction history, outstanding fees, interest accrual
output: Final balance amount calculated and documented

name: Standing Order and Direct Debit Processing
canonical_name: Standing Order and Direct Debit Processing
description: Processing and cancellation of any active standing orders and direct debit mandates on the account prior to closure.
input: List of active standing orders and direct debit mandates
output: Standing orders cancelled, direct debits processed or cancelled as appropriate

name: Closure Type Assessment
description: Determination of whether the closure is customer-initiated or bank-initiated, which determines the subsequent workflow path and investigation requirements.
output: Closure type determined (customer-initiated or bank-initiated)

name: Bank-Initiated Closure Investigation
description: Investigation and formal documentation of the reason for bank-initiated account closure, required before proceeding with closure.
input: Bank closure decision, account history, compliance flags
output: Investigation documented, closure reason recorded
failure_path: Escalate to compliance review if investigation inconclusive

name: Final Balance Transfer and Remittance
description: Transfer or remittance of the calculated final balance to the customer via their nominated payment method or account.
input: Final balance amount, customer remittance details
output: Final balance transferred to customer, remittance confirmation generated

name: Closure Confirmation Issuance
description: Issuance of formal written confirmation to the customer documenting the account closure, final balance, and closure date.
input: Closure details, final balance, remittance confirmation
output: Closure confirmation letter issued to customer

name: Record Archival
description: Archival of all account records and documentation for the mandatory retention period of 6 years in compliance with regulatory requirements.
output: Records archived for 6-year retention period

name: Account Status Update to Closed
description: Final system update marking the account status as closed, preventing any further transactions or activity on the account.
output: Account status changed to 'Closed' in system

name: Closure Type Determination Gate
description: Branching decision point that determines whether the closure is customer-initiated (standard processing path) or bank-initiated (investigation and documentation required path).
decision_question: Is the closure customer-initiated or bank-initiated?
criteria: Source of closure request and documented reason
path_yes: Customer-initiated: proceed with standard closure process (3–5 business days)
path_no: Bank-initiated: trigger investigation step, issue immediate notice to customer

name: Customer Account
description: The customer account subject to closure, which transitions from active status through the closure process to final closed status in the system.
closure_or_freeze_conditions: Customer-initiated closure request or bank-initiated closure decision

name: Account Closure Requestor

context_role: Account holder requesting closure or subject of bank-initiated closure

cancellation_process: Cancelled during account closure process step 4

name: Direct Debit Mandate
description: Active direct debit mandates on the account that must be processed and cancelled prior to account closure.
cancellation_or_dispute_process: Processed or cancelled during account closure process step 4

description: Operations team responsible for executing the account closure process steps, including identity verification, balance calculation, standing order/direct debit processing, and record archival.
authority_level: Execute closure process steps, verify customer identity, calculate final balance, process standing orders and direct debits, transfer funds, issue confirmation

name: Bank-Initiated Closure Investigator
description: Compliance or operations staff responsible for investigating and documenting the reason for bank-initiated account closures.
authority_level: Investigate bank-initiated closure reasons, document findings, escalate if necessary

name: Account Closure Process

The process begins with request capture and immediate verification actions.

Explain closure implications (no further transactions, interest stops, records archived)

name: Bank-Initiated Account Closure
description: End-to-end procedure for closing a customer account initiated by the bank due to regulatory violations, fraud, policy breaches, or dormancy. The process includes documented reasons, customer notification with standard 30-day notice (or immediate closure in emergency scenarios), and account freeze protocols for security risks.
context: Triggers for Bank-Initiated Closure: Regulatory Reason, Fraud, Policy Violation, Dormancy
Emergency Bank-Initiated Closure (No Notice): Immediate account freeze (if fraud/security risk confirmed)
purpose: Close customer account due to regulatory violation, fraud, policy breach, or dormancy
scope: All customer accounts subject to closure triggers
trigger: Dormancy after 5 years with no activity and failed contact attempts
outcome_success: Account closed with customer notified and reason documented
outcome_failure: Account remains open; regulatory or fraud risk unmitigated

name: Closure Initiation by Manager or Compliance Head
canonical_name: Closure Initiation by Manager or Compliance Head
key: closure initiation by manager or compliance head|PROCESS_STEP|banking.sop_guides
description: The first step in bank-initiated closure where a Manager or Compliance Head formally initiates the account closure process based on identified triggers.
output: Closure initiation recorded in system

description: The closure reason is formally documented in the system, categorized as regulatory, fraud, policy, or dormancy-related.
context: Document reason in system (regulatory, fraud, policy)
output: Reason documented in system (regulatory, fraud, or policy)

name: Customer Closure Notice Preparation
description: A formal notice is prepared for the customer explaining the account closure, with standard 30-day notice period except in emergency situations.
context: Prepare notice to customer (30-day notice required, except emergencies)
output: Closure notice letter prepared

name: Customer Notification Delivery
description: A letter is sent to the customer explaining the reason for account closure.
output: Customer notified of closure reason

context: Immediate account freeze (if fraud/security risk confirmed)
output: Account immediately frozen
failure_path: Escalate to senior compliance authority

name: Emergency Closure Completion
description: Following an emergency account freeze, the account closure is completed within 7 days with documented reason and same-day customer notification.
output: Account closed; customer notified same day

name: Manager or Compliance Head
description: The authorized role responsible for initiating bank-initiated account closures and making the decision to close an account based on regulatory, fraud, policy, or dormancy triggers.

description: Decision gate determining which closure trigger applies: regulatory violation, fraud, policy breach, or dormancy. This determines the closure pathway and notice requirements.
context: Triggers for Bank-Initiated Closure: Regulatory Reason, Fraud, Policy Violation, Dormancy
decision_question: Does the account meet closure trigger criteria?
criteria: Dormancy after 5 years with failed contact attempts
path_no: Account remains open; no closure action

decision_question: Is fraud or security risk confirmed?
path_yes: Emergency closure pathway: immediate freeze, closure within 7 days, same-day notification

context: Regulatory Reason: Compliance violation, AML breach, regulatory order

name: Fraud and Security Risk Verification
description: Mandatory compliance gate confirming whether fraud or security risk is present, determining whether emergency closure procedures (immediate freeze, same-day notification) are triggered.
context: Fraud: Account used fraudulently, customer identity issue, unauthorized access
Immediate account freeze (if fraud/security risk confirmed)
failure_consequence: Emergency closure pathway not triggered; standard closure applied

name: Customer Account
description: The customer account subject to bank-initiated closure due to regulatory, fraud, policy, or dormancy triggers.

name: Customer

investigation_or_escalation_path: Emergency closure pathway: immediate freeze, closure within 7 days

No legal holds (litigation, regulatory investigation, tax lien)
output: verification_result
delay_documentation
failure_path: Escalate to manager/Compliance Head for resolution

name: Customer Account

name: Balance Calculation Process
description: End-to-end procedure for calculating and documenting a customer account's final balance prior to closure. The process collects all transactions since the last statement, computes the final balance including pending interest and fees, generates a final statement, and obtains operations manager approval and sign-off.
context: Pull all transactions since last statement
Verify balance matches account record in AMS
purpose: Calculate and document final account balance for statement generation
scope: All customer accounts requiring statement closure or periodic balance verification
trigger: Statement period end or account closure request
outcome_success: Final balance calculated, documented, approved, and filed
outcome_failure: Balance discrepancy identified; escalation to reconciliation team

name: Collect All Transactions
description: Initial step to gather all financial transactions affecting the account since the last statement, including both posted and pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due), with verification that no deposits or withdrawals remain unprocessed.
context: Pull all transactions since last statement
Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)
output: Complete transaction list since last statement
failure_path: Escalate to Operations Manager for manual transaction verification

name: Calculate Final Balance
description: Computation step that determines the account's final balance by combining the ledger balance of posted transactions, adding any accrued but unpaid interest, subtracting pending fees and overdraft charges, and cross-verifying the result against the Account Management System (AMS) record.
context: Add any pending interest (if accrual period not yet completed)
Subtract any pending fees (overdraft, if applicable)
Verify balance matches account record in AMS
output: Final calculated balance
failure_path: Balance mismatch detected; manual reconciliation required

name: Document Balance
description: Step to formally record and communicate the final balance by printing a final statement that includes the calculation date, itemizes all pending transactions, and clearly displays the final balance figure.
output: Printed final statement with balance documentation
failure_path: Statement generation failure; retry or manual document creation

name: Approval of Final Statement
description: Final authorization step in which the operations manager reviews and verifies the balance calculation, provides formal sign-off on the final statement, and ensures the document is filed in the account closure record.
output: Signed-off final statement filed in account closure record
failure_path: Rejection triggers recalculation; escalation if repeated discrepancies

name: Operations Manager
description: Senior operations staff member responsible for verifying the accuracy of the final balance calculation, authorizing the final statement, and ensuring proper filing of closure documentation.
authority_level: Final approval authority for account balance statements

name: Posted Transaction
description: A financial transaction that has been fully processed and settled on the account ledger, forming the basis of the ledger balance used in final balance calculation.
context: Pull all transactions since last statement

name: Pending Transaction
description: A financial transaction that has been initiated but not yet fully processed or settled, including standing orders and direct debits due, which must be included in the final balance calculation.
context: Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)
monitoring_or_reporting_obligation: Included in final statement; listed separately from posted balance

name: Standing Order
description: A recurring payment instruction on the account that may be pending at the time of balance calculation and must be included as a pending transaction in the final statement.
context: Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)
setup_or_amendment_process: Included in pending transaction collection during balance calculation

name: Direct Debit
description: A direct debit mandate on the account that may be due at the time of balance calculation and must be included as a pending transaction in the final statement.
context: Include pending transactions (standing orders, direct debits due)
setup_or_amendment_process: Included in pending transaction collection during balance calculation

name: Customer Account

Last standing order executes if scheduled before closure date
